title: Cost-aware AWS preflight for T-2 EKS baseline
objective: Prepare the private EKS Terraform baseline and its bounded AWS state backend/apply identity for a later real-AWS validation.

include: Kubernetes version update to a standard-supported EKS version
private VPC endpoint design for required node bootstrap services
approved remote state backend and scoped apply role

allowed_mutations: NodeOperatorTerraformApply IAM role and scoped policy
caller assume-role permission and local AWS profile

acceptance: State bucket and lock table are private, encrypted, versioned, and TLS-only
Apply role trust and permissions are narrowly scoped and reviewed
No EKS/VPC resource is applied in this task
The baseline avoids EKS extended-support cost
Private node bootstrap dependencies and non-goals are explicit
A later apply task has a bounded teardown plan
